nodes.description: Pure addition helper that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
Pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a and returns c = a - b, guarding underflow.
Pure multiplication helper computing c = a * b with an overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure division helper requiring b > 0 and returning c = a / b.
Owner contract constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, establishing initial privileged account.
onlyOwner function that sets the pending newOwner address for two-step ownership transfer.
Function callable only by newOwner that finalizes ownership transfer and clears the pending owner.
Token constructor setting symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-funding the initial holder balance.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus the balance held at the zero address.
Constant function returning the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Public transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
Public approval writing the spender allowance of msg.sender into the allowed mapping.
Public delegated transfer moving tokens from a source and decrementing the caller allowance.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance from tokenOwner to spender.
Public function that sets an allowance and then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ether transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract to sweep tokens.
Public address holding the privileged owner of the Owned/AtromG8Token contracts.
Public address holding the pending owner awaiting acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to EAG8 in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to AtromG8 in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 8 in the constructor.
Public total token supply state variable set to 500000000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowance bookkeeping.
Arithmetic operation a + b inside safeAdd whose overflow safety depends on the require check.
Arithmetic operation a - b inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic operation a * b inside safeMul guarded by a division-based overflow check.
Arithmetic operation a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call to arbitrary spender contract receiveApproval executed inside approveAndCall.
External call to arbitrary token contract transfer executed inside transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: safeAdd performs the a+b arithmetic wrapped by its overflow require.
safeSub performs the a-b arithmetic guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the a*b arithmetic guarded by a division overflow check.
safeDiv performs a/b after requiring b > 0.

Parameter b feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Multiplication result stored in local c.
Parameter a feeds the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b feeds the division in safeDiv.
Division result stored in local c.

transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
Constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier authorizes transferOwnership via msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller via require(msg.sender == newOwner).

approve writes the allowance of msg.sender to spender.
transferFrom decrements the allowance of msg.sender as spender.
approveAndCall forwards caller-controlled msg.sender into an external callback.
approveAndCall executes an external call to the spender contract.
The external callee can re-enter and manipulate the allowed allowance mapping.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
The external token contract is invoked while the owner address is used as recipient.

acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner to address(0).
